name: Adachi Kasumi
source: The protagonist's childhood friend. He once confessed his feeling to her during their middle school graduation but she revealed she that had to move to her grandparents due to her parent's death. Years later, she is the owner of the inn the protagonist is staying at and has a husband who also works at the inn.
